name: stage3_lr_sweep
description: Per-architecture learning-rate sweep for the research models (validation split only). 1,500 steps of 16 x 512 bytes, full cosine schedule, seed 0. NoPE/ALiBi Transformers and the LTI Mamba reuse the LR chosen for their family. Extended to 0.016 and 0.032 because both families were still improving at 0.008.
